G2000.def:
ἐπισφαλής, -ές
(σφάλλω, to cause to full), [in LXX: Wis.9:14 (cf. -ῶς, Wis.4:4) * ;]
__1. prone to fall (Plat.).
__2. dangerous (Hipp., Plut., al.): At 27:9.†
(AS)

G2001.def:
ἐπ-ισχύω
[in LXX: Sir.29:1, 1Ma.6:6 * ;]
__1. to make stronger (Sir, l.with).
__2. to grow stronger; metaphorically, be more urgent: Lc 23:5.†
(AS)

G2002.def:
ἐπι-σωρεύω
[in Sm.: Jó 14:17, Ct 2:4 * ;]
to heap together; metaphorically, διδασκάλους, 2Tm 4:3.†
(AS)

G2003.def:
ἐπι-ταγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιτάσσω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 3:16 (פִּתְגָּם), I Et 1:18, Wis.14:16 18:16 19:6, 3Ma.7:20 * ;]
= cl., ἐπίταγμα,
a command, Rm 16:26, 1Co 7:6 7:25, 2Co 8:8, 1Tm 1:1, Tt 1:3 (for use in Inscr. of divine commands, see MM, Exp., xiv); μετὰ πάσης ἐ, with all authority: Tt 2:15.†
(AS)

G2004.def:
ἐπι-τάσσω
[in LXX for אָמַר, צָוָה, etc. ;]
to command, charge: with accusative of thing(s), Lc 14:22; with dative of person(s), Mc 1:27 9:25, Lc 4:36 8:25; id. with accusative of thing(s), Phm 8; id. with inf., Mc 6:39, Lc 8:31, At 23:2; id. with imperat., Mc 9:25; with accusative and inf., Mc 6:27.†
SYN.: κελεύω (AS)

G2005.def:
ἐπι-τελέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for כָּלָה, עָשָׂה, etc. ;]
to complete, accomplish, execute: with accusative of thing(s), Rm 15:28, 2Co 7:1 8:6 8:11, Fp 1:6, Hb 8:5; of religious services (cf. Hdt., ii, 37, al.), Hb 9:6; art. inf., 2Co 8:11. Mid.,
__(a) to complete for oneself, make an end (R, mg.; pass., R, txt; cf. Meyer, in l): Gl 3:3;
__(b) to pay in full, pay the tax, be subject to: with accusative (cf. Xen., Mem., iv, 8, 8), 1Pe 5:9 (pass., RV, etc.; cf. Thayer, see word; ICC, in 1).†
(AS)

G2006.def:
ἐπιτήδειος, -α, -ον
[in LXX: 1Cr 28:2, Wis.4:5, 1Ma.4:46, al. ;]
__1. suitable, convenient,
__2. useful, necessary: τὰ ἐ., necessaries, Tg 2:16,†
(AS)

G2007.def:
ἐπι-τίθημι
[in LXX for נָתַן, שָׁוָה, etc. ;]
__1. to lay, set or place upon: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), Mt 23:4, Lc 15:5, Jo 9:6 (WH, txt. Jo 9:15), At 15:10 28:3; ἐπί, with genitive of thing(s), Mt 27:29; ἐν, ib.; with dative of person(s), σταυρόν, Lc 23:26; στέφανον, Jo 19:2; ὄνομα, Mc 3:16-17; πληγάς, Lc 10:30, At 16:23; ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Ap 22:18; of the laying on of hands, τ. χεῖρα (-ας), before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Mt 9:18, Mc 16:13, At 8:17 9:17; with dative of person(s), Mt 19:13, 15, Mc 5:23 6:5 7:32 8:23, Lc 4:40 13:13, At 6:6 8:19 9:12 13:3 19:6 28:8, 1Tm 5:22. Mid.,
__(a) to provide: At 28:10 (RV, put on board; cf. Field, Notes, 149);
__(b) to throw oneself upon, attack: with dative of person(s), At 18:10.
__2. to add to: Ap 22:18 (see supr., and cf. Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G2008.def:
ἐπι-τιμάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for גָּעַר, Gn 37:10, Sl 9:5, Zc 3:2; Sir.11:7, al. ;]
__1. to honour.
__2. to raise in price
__3. to mete out due measure;
__(a) to award;
__(b) to censure, rebuke, admonish: absol., 2Tm 4:2; with dative, Mt 8:26 17:13 19:13, Mc 4:39 8:32 10:13, Lc 4:39, 41 8:24 9:21, 42 9:55 17:3 18:15 19:39, Ju 9; before ἵνα, Mt 12:16 16:20 20:31, Mc 3:12 8:30 10:48, Lc 18:39; before λέγων, λέγει, etc., Mt 16:22, Mc 1:25 8:33 9:25, Lc 4:35 23:40.†
SYN.: ἐλέγχω, q.v (AS)

G2009.def:
ἐπιτιμία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιτιμάω), [in LXX: Wis_3:10 * ;]
__1. citizenship, franchise.
__2. As in Inscr. (LS, see word), LXX, l.with (= cl. τὸ ἐπιτίμιον), punishment, penalty: 2Co 2:6.†
(AS)

G2010.def:
ἐπι-τρέπω
[in LXX (usually with seel. ἐπιστρ-): Gn 39:6 (עָזַב), etc. ;]
__1. to turn to, commit, entrust.
__2. to yield, permit: 1Co 16:7, Hb 6:3; with dative of person(s), Mc 5:13, Jo 19:38; id. with inf. (cf. M, Pr., 205), Mt 8:21 19:8, Lc 8:32 9:52, 61 At 21:39-40 27:3, 1Tm 2:12; with inf., Mc 10:4. Pass., with dative and inf., At 26:1 28:16, 1Co 14:34.†
(AS)

G2011.def:
ἐπι-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.13:14 * ;]
power to decide, authority: At 26:12.†
(AS)

G2012.def:
ἐπίτροπος, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.11:1 2Mac 13:2 2Mac 14:2 * ;]
__1. an administrator, a steward: Mt 20:3, Lc 8:3.
__2. a guardian (with genitive of person(s), 2Mac, ll. with): Gl 4:2.†
(AS)

G2013.def:
ἐπι-τυγχάνω
[in LXX: Gn 39:2 (צָלַח hi.), Pv 12:27 (חָרַךְ)* ;]
__1. to light upon.
__2. to obtain, attain to: Tg 4:2, with genitive of thing(s) (as in cl.), Hb 6:15 11:33; with accusative (late Gk.), Rm 11:7 (Rec. τούτου).†
(AS)

G2014.def:
ἐπι-φαίνω
[in LXX for עוּר hi., etc. ;]
__1. to show forth.
__2. (= pass. in cl.) to appear: At 27:20; with dative of person(s), Lc 1:79; metaphorically, Tt 3:4; with dative, Tt 2:11 (Cremer, 567).†
(AS)

G2015.def:
ἐπιφάνεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιφανής), [in LXX: 2Rs 7:23 (יָרֵא), Et 5:1, Am 5:22, 2Ma.2:21 2Mac 3:24 2Mac 5:4 2Mac 12:22 2Mac 14:16 2Mac 15:27, 3Ma.2:9 3Mac 5:8 3Mac 5:51,* ;] (in late Gk. and Inscr., frequently of deities, see MM, Exp., xiv)
a manifestation, appear­ance: 2Ts 2:8, 1Tm 6:14, 2Tm 1:10 4:1 4:8, Tt 2:13 (cf. M, Th., 148 f.).†
(AS)

G2016.def:
ἐπιφανής, -ές
(ἐπιφαίνω), [in LXX (see Thayer, see word) for יָרֵא, etc., Jz 13:6, Jl 2:11, 31 al.; 2Ma.6:23, 3Ma.5:35, al. ;]
renowned, illustrious, notable: At 2:20 (LXX) (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G2017.def:
ἐπι-φαύσκω
(variant form of ἐπιφώσκω, which see), [in LXX: Jó 25:5 (אהל hi.) Jó 31:26 41:18 (הָלַל hi.) * ;]
to shine forth: figuratively, with dative, Ef 5:14 (on seel. -ψαύσει, see ICC, Westc., AR, in l).†
(AS)

G2018.def:
ἐπι-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַח ;]
__1. to bring upon or against: κρίσιν, Ju 9.
__2. to impose, inflict: Rm 3:5.†
(AS)

G2019.def:
ἐπι-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Et 9:47 AR, 2Ma.1:23, 3Ma.7:13 * ;]
to call out, shout: with accusative of thing(s), At 21:34; with dative of person(s), At 22:24; before λέγοντες, Lc 23:21; prat. rect., At 12:22.†
(AS)

G2020.def:
ἐπι-φώσκω
[in LXX for הָלַל hi., Jó 41:18 A (Βא, ἐπιφαύσκ-) * ;]
__1. to let shine.
__2. to dawn (cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Lc 23:54; before εἰς, Mat_28:1.†
(AS)

G2021.def:
ἐπιχειρέω, -ῶ
(χεῖρ), [in LXX for חָשַׁב, Êx 9:25; גָּמַל, 2Cr 20:11, al. ;]
__1. to pat one's hand to.
__2. to take in hand, attempt: with inf., Lc 1:1, At 9:29 19:13.†
(AS)

G2022.def:
ἐπι-χέω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצַק. Gn 28:18, al. ;]
to pour upon: Lc 10:34.†
(AS)

G2023.def:
ἐπι-χορηγέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir.25:22, 2Ma.4:9 A * ;]
to supply, provide: with accusative of thing(s), 2Pe 1:5; id. with dative of person(s), 2Co 9:10, Gl 3:5; pass., Cl 2:19, 2Pe 1:11 (cf. χορηγέω, and see MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G2025.def:
ἐπι-χρίω
[in Sm.: Eze.13:10 22:28 * ;]
to spread on, anoint: with accusative, Jo 9:11; id. before hi-I, with accusative, Jo 9:6 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G2026.def:
ἐπ-οικοδομέω, -ῶ
in NT, always metaphorically, of the spiritual life regarded as a building (Cremer, 449);
__1. to build upon: 1Co 3:10 3:12 3:14; pass., Ef 2:20.
__2. to build up: Cl 2:7, 1Pe 2:5 (T, οἰκοδ- WH, Rec.), Ju 20.†
(AS)

G2027.def:
ἐπι-κέλλω
of a ship, to run ashore: with accusative, At 27:41.†
(AS)

G2028.def:
ἐπ-ονομάζω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to name, call by a name, surname: pass., Rm 2:17.†
(AS)

G2029.def:
ἐπ-οπτεύω
[in Sm.: Sl 10:14 33:13 * ;]
to watch (in Hom., as an overseer; cf Ps, ll. with), look upon: 1Pe 2:12 3:2.†
(AS)

G2030.def:
ἐπόπτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX (of God): Et 5:1, 2Ma.3:39 2Mac 7:35, 3Ma.2:21 * ;]
__1. an overseer (LXX, ll. with).
__2. a spectator: 2Pe 1:16 (of ἐ. as applied to God, see parallels in Inscr., MM, Exp., xiv; of the use of this term in the mysteries, see Mayor on 2Pe, l.with; Thayer, see word).†
(AS)

G2031.def:
ἔπος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX: Zc 7:3, Sir.44:5 * ;]
a word: ὡς ἔ. εἰπεῖν (cl.), so to speak: Hb 7:9.†
SYN.: λόγος, reasoned speech; ῥῆμα, mere articulated utterance; ἔ., the articulated expression of a thought (AS)

G2032.def:
ἐπουράνιος, -ον
(οὐρανός), [in LXX: Sl 68:14 (שַׁדַּי), DA TH Dn 4:23 A (שָׁמַיִם) 2Ma.3:39, 3Ma.6:28 3Mac 7:6, 4Ma.4:11 AR, 4Ma.11:3 א* ;]
in or of heaven, heavenly (in Hom., of the Gods): οἱ ἐ., opposite to ἐπίγειοι and καταχθόνιοι, Fp 2:10; to χοϊκός, 1Co 15:48-49; σώματα (see Lft., Col., 376), 1Co 15:40; βασιλεία, 2Tm 4:18; παπρίς, Hb 11:16; Ἱερουσαλήμ, Hb 12:22; κλῆσις (cf. Lft. on Fp 3:14), Hb 3:1; τὰ ἐ., Hb 8:5 9:23; opposite to ἐπίγειος, Jo 3:12; id., of the heavenly regions, Ef 1:3, 20 2:6 3:10 6:12; ἡ δωρεὰ ἡ ἐ., Hb 6:4 (Cremer, 468).†
(AS)

G2033.def:
ἐπτά, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
seven: Mt 12:45 18:22 (cf. ἑβδομηκοντάκις), Mc 8:5, al.; οἱ ἐ, At 21:8
(AS)

G2036.def:
εἶπον, 2 aorist of obsolete present ἔπω (cf. Veitch), used as aorist of λέγω, which see
(AS)

G2037.def:
Ἐραστος, -ου, ὁ
Erastus;
__1. a companion of St. Paul, At 19:22, and prob. 2Tm 4:20.
__2. The treasurer of Corinth, Rm 16:23.†
(AS)

G2038.def:
ἐργάζομαι
(ἔργον), [in LXX for עָבַד, פָּעַל, עָשָׂה, etc. ;]
__1. intrans.,
__(a) to work, labour: Mt 21:28, Lc 13:14, Jo 5:17 9:4 b, At 18:3, 1Co 9:6, 2Ts 3:10-12; τ. χερσίν, 1Co 4:12, 1Ts 4:11; νυκτὸς κ. ἡαέρας, 1Ts 2:9, 2Ts 3:8; of working for pay, Mt 21:28; for reward, Rm 4:4-5;
__(b) to work at a trade or business, to trade: before Iv (Dem.), Mt 25:16.
__2. Trans.,
__(a) to work, work out, do, produce, perform: with accusative, 2Co 7:10, Cl 3:23, 2Ts 3:11, Tg 1:20, 2Jn.8, before εἰς, III Jn 5; ἔργον, At 13:41 (LXX); id. before εἰς, Mt 26:10; ἐν, Mc 14:6; ἔργα, Jo 3:21; τὰ ἔ. τ. θεοῦ, Jo 6:28 9:4; τὸ ἔ. κυρίου, 1Co 16:10; τ. ἀγαθόν, Rm 2:10, Ef 4:28 (see AR, Eph.) 190); id. before πρός, Gl 6:10; κακόν, before dative of person(s) (more frequently dupl. accusative, in cl.), Rm 13:10; δικαιοσύνην, At 10:35, Hb 11:33; ἀνομίαν, Mt 7:23; ἁμαρτίαν, Tg 2:9; σημεῖον, Jo 6:30; τ. ἱερά, 1Co 9:13; τ. θάλασσαν (work the sea, i.e. make one's living from it), Ap 18:17;
__(b) to work for, earn by working (cl.): Jo 6:27 (cf. κατ-, περι-, προσ-εργάζομαι; Cremer, 258; on the force of the aorist of this verb, see M, Pr., 116).†
(AS)

G2039.def:
ἐργασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔργον), [in LXX for מְלָאכָה, עֲבֹדָה, etc. ;]
__1. work, business: At 16:16, 19 19:24-25; δὸς ἐ. (Lat. da operam), Lc 12:58.
__2. working, performance: Ef 4:19.†
(AS)

G2040.def:
ἐργάτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐργάζομαι, which see), [in LXX: Wis.17:17, Sir.19:1 40:18, 1Ma.3:6 * ;]
__1. prop., a field labourer, husbandman: Mt 9:37-38 20:1-2, 8, Lc 10:2, Tg 5:4 (cf. Wis, l.with).
__2. Generally, a workman, labourer: Mt 10:10, Lc 10:7, At 19:25 (opposite to τεχνίτης), 1Tm 5:18; of Christian teachers, 2Co 11:13, Fp 3:2, 2Tm 2:15.
__3. a worker, doer: τ. ἀδικίας, Lc 13:27 (cf. 1Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G2041.def:
ἔργον, -ου, τό (originally Ϝέργον, work), [very frequently in LXX, chiefly for מַשֶׂה, מְלָאכָה, also for עֲבֹדָה, פֹּעַל, etc. ;]
__1. work, task, employment: Mc 13:34, Jo 4:34 17:4, At 13:2, Fp 1:22 2:30, 1Ts 5:13, al.; of an enterprise or undertaking (Dt 15:10, Wis.2:12), At 5:38.
__2. a deed, action: Tt 1:16, Tg 1:25 . listing, from λόγος, Lc 24:19, Rm 15:18, 2Ts 2:17, 1Jo 3:18; ἐν λόγοις κ. ἔ., At 7:22; of acts of God, Jo 9:3, At 13:41" (LXX), Hb 4:10, Ap 15:3; of Christ, Mt 11:2; esp. in Jo, e.g. 5:20, 36 7:3 10:38 14:11, 12 15:24; in ethical sense, of human actions (AR, Eph., 190), bad or good, Mt 23:3, Lc 11:48, Jo 3:20, 21 Tg 2:14ff. 3:13, Ap 2:5 3:8; τὸ ἔ., collectively, Gl 6:4, Tg 1:4, 1Pe 1:17, Ap 22:12; τὸ ἔ. τ. νόμου, Rm 2:15; ἔ. ἀγαθόν, Rm 2:7, Cl 1:10, 2Ts 2:17, Tt 1:16, al.; καλόν, Mt 26:10, Mc 14:6; pl. (as frequently in cl.), Mt 5:16, 1Tm 5:10, 25 Hb 10:24; ἔ. πίστεως, 1Ts 1:3, 2Ts 1:11; ἔ. πονηρά, Cl 1:21, 2Jo.11; νέκρα, Hb 6:1 9:14; ἄκαρπα, Ef 5:11; ἔ. ἀσεβείας, Ju 15; τ. σκότους, Rm 13:12, Ef 5:11; ἔ. νόμου, Rm 3:20, 28 Gl 2:16 3:2, 5 10.
__3. that which is wrought or made, a work: 1Co 3:13-15; τ. χειρῶν, At 7:41; of the works of God, Hb 1:10; γῆ κ. τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔ., 2Pe 3:10; τὸ ἔ. τ. θεοῦ, Rm 14:20.
(AS)

G2042.def:
ἐρεθίζω
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:10, 25 (גָּרָה hithp.), 1Ma.15:40, 2Ma.14:17, etc. ;]
__1. to stir up, provoke (as in cl.): Cl 3:21.
__2. In good sense (cf. ἐρεθισμός, excitement, in MGr.), to stir up, stimulate: 2Co 9:2.†
(AS)

G2043.def:
ἐρείδω
(chiefly in poets and late prose for ἐρυγγάνω), [in LXX for תָּמַךְ (Pv 4:4 5:5 11:16, al.), etc. ;]
to prop, fix firmly: act., as mid., ἐρείσασα, of a ship driving ashore (RV, struck), At 27:41.†
(AS)

G2044.def:
ἐρεύγομαι
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַג, Os 11:10, Am 3:4, 8 al.; also for נָבַע, Sl 19:2, etc. ;]
__1. to spit or spue out.
__2. Prop., of oxen (Hom.), to bellow, roar; whence, as in LXX, to speak aloud, utter: Mt 13:35 (LXX). (For other examples of softened force of words in late Gk., cf. σκύλλω, τρώγω, χορτάζω.) †
(AS)

G2045.def:
ἐραυνάω, -ῶ late form of ἐρευνάω (Rec., ll. with; cf. Bl., § 6, 1; M, Pr., 46),
[in LXX, ἐρευν- (exc. 1Cr 19:3 A), for חָפַשׂ pi., חָקַר, etc. ;]
to search, examine: Jo 7:52; with accusative of thing(s), Jo 5:39, Rm 8:27, 1Co 2:10, Ap 2:23; before orat. obliq., 1Pe 1:11.†
SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω (AS)

G2046.def:
λέγω,
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, Gn 22:16, al. ;]
__1. in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount.
__2. In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., At 13:15, 24:10; before orat. dir., Mt 9:34, Mc 3:11, Jo 1:29, al.; before ὅτι recit., Mc 3:21, Lc 1:24, Jo 6:14, al.; accusative and inf., Lc 11:18, Jo 12:29, al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, Mt 11:17, al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), Mt 25:9, Mc 3:33, 7:28, Lc 24:6, 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Mt 3:9, Lc 3:8, al.; of writing, 2Co 8:8, Fp 4:11, al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, Rm 4:3, Tg 2:23, al.; with accusative of thing(s), Lc 8:8, 9:33, Jo 5:34, al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), Mt 27:11, Mc 15:2, Lc 23:3, Jo 18:37; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., Mt 8:20, Mc 2:17, al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, Mt 3:9, al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., Mc 4:41, Jo 11:56, Hb 9:5, al.; to mean (cl.), Mc 14:71, Jo 6:71, 1Co 10:29, al.; to call, name, Mc 10:18; pass., Mt 9:9, Mc 15:7, al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω).
SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

G2047.def:
ἐρημία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔρημος), [in LXX: Is 60:20, Eze.35:4 (חָרַב, חׇרְבָּה), Eze.35:9 (שְׁמָמָה), Wis.17:17, Sir.47:17, Bar.4:33, 4Ma.18:8 * ;]
a solitude, wilderness: Mt 15:33, Mc 8:4, 2Co 11:26, Hb 11:38.†
(AS)

G2048.def:
ἔρημος
(in older Gk. ἔρῆμος), -ον [in LXX chiefly for מִדְבָּר ;]
solitary, lonely, desolate, deserted:
__(a) of persons, γυνή, Gl 4:27 (LXX);
__(b) of places, Mt 14:13, 15 23:38 (WH, om.), Mc 1:36 6:32, Lc 4:42 9:12, al.; as subst., ἡ ἔ. (sc. χώρα; as in Hdt., ii, 32, al.), the desert, Mt 3:1, 3, Mc 1:3-4, Jo 3:14, al.; pl., αἱ ἔ., desert places, Lc 1:80 5:16 8:29
(AS)

G2049.def:
ἐρημόω, -ῶ
(ἔρημος), [in LXX for חָרַב hi., שָׁמֵם ni., etc. ;]
to desolate, lay waste: Mt 12:25, Lc 11:17, Ap 17:16 18:16, 19.†
(AS)

G2050.def:
ἐρήμωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐρημόω), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם, שָׁמֵם, Lv 26:34-35, Sl 73:10, Dn 9:27 11:31 12:11, al.; חׇרְבָּה, Jr 7:34 22:5, al. ;]
a making desolate, laying waste: Lc 21:20; βδέλυγμα ἐρημώσεως (Da, ll. with, 1Ma.1:54), Mt 24:15" (LXX), Mc 13:14.†
(AS)

G2051.def:
ἐρίζω
(ἔρις), [in LXX for מָרָה, etc. ;]
to wrangle, strive: Mt 12:19 (LXX, κεκράζεται).†
(AS)

G2052.def:
ἐριθία
(T, cl., -εία), -ας, ἡ, [in Sm.: Eze.23:11 * ;] (on the origin and history of the word, see Hort, Ja., 81 fly.; Ellic. on Gl 5:20; Cremer, 262)
ambition, self-seeking, rivalry: Tg 3:14, 16; κατ᾽ ἐριθίαν, Fp 2:3; οἱ ἐξ ἐ., Rm 2:8, Fp 1:17; pl. (Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153), 2Co 12:20, Gl 5:20.†
(AS)

G2053.def:
ἔριον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for צֶמֶר, Lv 13:47, Is 1:18, al. ;]
wool: Hb 9:19, Ap 1:14.†
(AS)

G2054.def:
ἔρις, -ιδος accusative, ἔριν (on the declension, see B1., § 8, 3; WH, App., 157), ἡ,
[in LXX: Sl 139:20, Sir.28:11 40:5, 9 * ;]
strife, wrangling, contention: Rm 1:29 13:13, 1Co 3:3, 2Co 12:20, Gl 5:20, Fp 1:15, 1Tm 6:4, Tt 3:9; pl. (see: ἐριθία), Rm 13:13, WH, mg., 1Co 1:11, Ga, l.with, WH, mg.†
(AS)

G2055.def:
ἐρίφιον, -ου, τό
(dim, of ἔριφος, which see) [in LXX: Tob.2:13 * ;]
Mt 25:33, Lc 15:29 (ἔριφον, WH, txt.).†
(AS)

G2056.def:
ἔριφος, -ου
[in LXX chiefly for גְּדִי ;]
a kid: Mt 25:32, Lc 15:29, WH, txt.†
(AS)

G2057.def:
Ἑρμᾶς, -ᾶ, accusative, -ᾶν (Doric form of Ἑρμῆς),
Hermas, a Christian: Rm 16:14.†
(AS)

G2058.def:
ἑρμηνεία, see: ἑρμηνία.
ἑρμηνία (T, cl., -εία), -ας, ἡ,
(ἑρμηνεύω), [in LXX (-εία), Sir, prol. 14 Sir.47:17, from LXX Sir.5:1 * ;]
interpretation: 1Co 12:10 14:26.†
(AS)

G2059.def:
ἑρμηνεύω
[in LXX: Et 4:7 (תִּרְגַּם), Et 10:3 Jó 42:17β* ;]
__1. to explain.
__2. to interpret: Lc 24:27 (WH, mg.), Jo 1:39, 43 9:7, Hb 7:2.†
(AS)

G2060G.def:
Ἑρμῆς, -οῦ
accusative, Ἑρμῆν, ὁ,
Hermes;
__(a) the Greek god (Lat. Mercurius): At 14:12;
__(b) a Christian: Rm 16:14.† (see)
(AS)

G2060H.def:
Ἑρμῆς, -οῦ
accusative, Ἑρμῆν, ὁ,
Hermes;
__(a) the Greek god (Lat. Mercurius): At 14:12;
__(b) a Christian: Rm 16:14.† (see)
(AS)

G2062.def:
ἑρπετόν, -οῦ, τό
(ἕρπω, to crawl), [in LXX chiefly for רֶמֶשׂ, שֶׁרֶץ ;]
a creeping thing, reptile: At 10:12 11:6, Rm 1:23, Tg 3:7.†
(AS)

G2063.def:
ἐρυθρός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for אֱדֹם, Is 63:2; ἐ. θάλασσα for סוּף -יָם Êx 10:19, al. ;]
red: ἡ ἐ. θάλασσα, the Red Sea, At 7:36, Hb 11:29.†
(AS)

G2064.def:
ἔρχομαι,
[in LXX very frequently for בּוֹא, also for הלךְ ni., אתה, etc., 34 words in all ;]
__1. to come;
__(a) of persons, either as arriving or returning from elsewhere: Mt 8:9, Mc 6:31, Lc 7:8, Jo 4:27, Rm 9:9, al.; before ἀπό, Mc 5:35 7:1, Jo 3:2, al.; ἐκ, Lc 5:17, Jo 3:31, al.; εἰς, Mc 1:29, al.; διά before εἰς, Mc 7:31; ἐν (Cremer, 263f., but see: ἐν), Rm 15:29, 1Co 4:21; ἐπί, with accusative, Mc 6:53 11:13, Jo 19:33, al.; κατά, with accusative, Lc 10:33 At 16:7; παρά, with genitive, Lc 8:49; with accusative, Mt 15:29, Mc 9:14, al.; with dative comm., incomm. (M, Pr., 75, 245), Mt 21:5, Ap 2:5, 16; with adverbs: πόθεν, Jo 3:8, al.; ἄνωθεν, Jo 3:31; ὄπισθεν, Mc 5:27; ὧδε, Mt 8:29; ἐκεῖ, Jo 18:3; ποῦ, Hb 11:8; before ἕως, Lc 4:42; ἄχρι, At 11:5; with purpose expressed by inf., Mc 5:14, Lc 1:59, al.; by fut. ptcp., Mt 27:49; ἵνα, Jo 12:9; εἰς τοῦτο, ἵνα, At 9:21; διά, with accusative, Jo 12:9; before verbs of action, ἔρχεται καί, ἦλθε καί, etc.: Mc 2:18, Jo 6:15, al.; ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε, Jo 1:47 11:34; ἐλθών (redundant; Dalman, Words, 20 f.), Mt 2:8 8:7, Mc 7:25, At 16:39, al.; similarly ἐρχόμενος, Lc 15:25, al.; of coming into public view: esp. of the Messiah (ὁ ἐρχόμενος, Mt 11:3, al.; see Cremer, 264), Lc 3:16, Jo 4:25; hence, of Jesus, Mt 11:19, Lc 7:34, Jo 5:43, al.; of the second coming, Mt 10:23, At 1:11, 1Co 4:5, 1Ts 5:2, al.;
__(b) of time: ἔρξονται ἡμέραι (present for fut.: Bl., §56, 8), Lc 23:29, Hb 8:8" (LXX) ; fut., Mt 9:15, Mc 2:20, al.; ἔρξεται ὥρα, ὅτε, Jo 4:21, 23. al.; ἦλθεν, ἐλήλυθε ἡ ὥρα, Jo 13:1 16:32 17:1; ἡ ἡμέρα τ. κυρίου, 1Ts 5:2; καιροί, At 3:19;
__(with) of things and events: κατακλυσμός, Lc 17:27; λιμός, At 7:11; ἡ ὀργή, 1Ts 1:10; ὁ λύχνος, Mc 4:21 (see Swete, in l.). Metaphorical, τ. ἀγαθά, Rm 3:8; τ. τέλειον, 1Co 13:10; ἡ πίστις, Gl 3:23, 25; ἡ ἐντολή, Rm 7:9; with prepositions: ἐκ τ. θλίψεως, Ap 7:14; ἐις τ. χεῖρον, Mc 5:26; εἰς πειρασμόν, ib. 14:38, al.
__2. to go: ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), Mt 16:24, Mc 8:34, Lc 9:23; σύν, Jo 21:3; ὁδόν, Lc 2:44. (Cf. ἀν-, ἐπ-αν-, ἀπ-, δι-, εἰς, ἐπ-εἰσ-, συν-εἰσ-, ἐξ-, δι-εξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, παρ-, ἀντι-παρ-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-έρχομαι.)
SYN.: πορεύομαι, χωρέω (v, Thayer, see word ἔρξομαι). (AS)

G2065.def:
ἐρωτάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל ;]
__1. to ask, question (cl.): absol., Lc 19:31 22:68, Jo 8:7 with accusative of person(s), Jo 9:21 16:19, 30 8:21; before λέγων, Mt 16:13, Lc 23:3, Jo 1:19, 21 5:12 9:19 16:5; with dupl. accusative (WM, § 32, 4a), Mt 21:24, Mc 4:10, Lc 20:3, Jo 16:23 (M, Pr., 66„); with accusative of person(s), before περί, Lc 9:45, Jo 18:19.
__2. In late Gk. (Milligan, NTD, 51; not, as Cremer, 716, Thayer, see word, a "Hebraism"), = αἰτέω (which see), to ask, request: with accusative of person(s), Jo 14:16; before imperat., Lc 14:18-19 Fp 4:3; λέγων, Mt 15:23, Jo 12:21; before ἵνα (M, Pr., 208), Mc 7:26, Lc 7:36 16:27, Jo 4:47 17:15 19:31, 38, 1Ts 4:1, 2Jn.5; ὅπως, Lc 7:3 11:37, At 23:20; with inf., Lc 5:3 8:37, Jo 4:40, At 3:3 10:48 23:18, 1Ts 5:12; with accusative of person(s), before περί, Lc 4:38 Jo 17:9, 20, 1Jo 5:16; ὑπέρ, 2Ts 2:1-2; τὰ (WH, txt., om. τὰ) πρὸς εἰρήνην, Lc 14:32 (cf. δι-, ἐπ-ερωτάω)
SYN.: see: αἰτέω (AS)

G2066.def:
ἐσθής, -ῆτος, ἡ
(ἕννυμι, to clothe; hence, ἐσθής, Lk, ll with, Elz.) [in LXX: 1Es.8:71 Et 8:73, 2Ma.8:35 2Mac 11:8 * ;]
clothing, raiment: Lc 23:11 24:4, At 10:30 12:21, Tg 2:2-3.†
(AS)

G2068.def:
ἐσθίω, and (poet, and late prose) ἔσθω,
[in LXX chiefly for אכל ;]
to eat;
__(a) absol.: Mt 14:20, 21 Mc 6:31, Jo 4:31, al.; ἐν τ. φαγεῖν (on this aor. form, see M, Pr., 111), 1Co 11:21; διδόναι φαγεῖν, with dative of person(s), Mc 5:43, al.; ἐ. καὶ πίνειν, Mt 6:25, 31 Lc 10:7, al.; of ordinary use of food and drink, 1Co 9:4 11:22; of partaking of food at table, Mc 2:16, Lc 5:30, al.; opposite to fasting, Mt 11:18, Lc 5:33, al.; of revelling, Mt 24:49, Lc 12:45 .
__(b) with accusative of thing(s): Mt 6:25, Mc 1:6, Jo 6:31, Rm 14:2, al.; ἄρτον (Heb. אָכַל לֶחֶם), Mt 15:2, Mc 3:20, al.; τὸν ἑαυτοῦ ἄ., 2Ts 3:12; ἄ. before παρά, genitive of person(s), 2Ts 3:8; τά before id., Lc 10:7; τ. πάσχα, Mt 26:17, Mc 14:12 al; τ. κυριακὸν δεῖπνον, 1Co 11:20; τ. θυσίας, 1Co 10:18; before ἐκ (= cl. part. genitive), Jo 6:26, 5o, 51, 1Co 11:28; ἀπό (cf. Heb. אָכַל מִן), Mt 15:27, Mc 7:28; metaphorically, to devour, consume: Hb 10:27, Tg 5:3, Ap 17:16 (cf. κατ-, συν-εσθίω) .
(AS)

G2069.def:
Ἐσλεί (Rec. 'Ἐσλί, see WH, Notes, 155), ὁ,
Esli, an ancestor of Jesus: Lc 3:25.†
(AS)

G2072.def:
ἔσ-οπτρον, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Wis.7:26, Sir.12:11 * ;]
a mirror: 1Co 13:12, Tg 1:23.†
(AS)

G2073.def:
ἑσπέρα, -ας, ἡ
(prop, fem, of ἕσπερος), [in LXX chiefly for עָרַב ;]
__(a) (sc. ὥρα), evening: Lc 24:29, At 4:3 20:15 28:23;
__(b) (so. χώρα), the west.†
(AS)

G2074.def:
Ἑσρώμ
(Ἑσρών, Lk, l.with; Rec. Ἑσρ-), ὁ (Heb. חֶצְרוֹן, Gn 46:12, Nm 26:21, 1Cr 25:1-31, al.), [in LXX both forms, ut supr. (cf. ICC, on Mt, l.with; WH, § 408) ;]
Esrom (AV), Hezron (RV), an ancestor of Jesus: Mt 13:1-58, Lc 3:35.†
(AS)

G2078.def:
ἔσχατος, -η, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for אַחֲרִית אַחֲרוֹן ;]
last, utmost, extreme;
__(a) of place: of the lowest or least honoured place, Lc 14:9-10; τ. ἔσχατον, with genitive part., At 1:8 13:47;
__(b) of time: Mt 20:12, 14, Mc 12:6, 22, opposite to πρῶτος, Mt 20:8, 1Co 15:45, Ap 2:19, al.; τὰ ἔ. καὶ T. πρῶτα, Mt 12:45, Lc 11:26, 2Pe 2:20; of the Eternal, ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔ., Ap 1:17 2:8 22:13; in phrases relating to the Messianic age and the consummation of the Kingdom of God: ἐπ᾽ ἐσχάτου (-ων) τ. ἡμερῶν, Hb 1:2, 2Pe 3:3; τ. χρόνων, 1Pe 1:20; ἔ. ὥρα, 1Jo 2:18; ἐπ᾽ ἐ. χόνου, Ju 18; ἐν ἐ. ἡμέραις, At 2:17, Tg 5:3, 2Tm 3:1; neut., ἔσχατον, as adv., Mc 12:22, 1Co 15:8;
__(with) of rank: Mc 9:35, 1Co 4:9
(AS)

G2079.def:
ἐσχάτως
adv.,
extremely, utterly; ἐ. ἔχειν (= Lat. in extremis esse), only in late writers (cf. ἐν ἐσχάτοις εἶναι, FlJ, Ant., ix, 8, 6), to be at the point of death: Mc 5:28.†
(AS)

G2080.def:
ἔσω Ion, and old Att.. form of εἴσω
(εἰς),
adv., [in LXX for etc. ;]
__1. prop., after verbs of motion (to) within, into: Mt 26:58, Mc 14:54; with genitive, Mc 15:16.
__2. As frequently in cl. (= cl. ἔνδον), after verbs of rest, within: Jo 20:26, At 5:23; οἱ ἔ. (opposite to οἱ ἔξω), 1Co 5:12; ὁ ἔ. ἄνθρωπος, Rm 7:22, 2Co 4:16, Ef 3:16.†
(AS)

G2081.def:
ἔσωθεν
(ἔσω),
adv., [in LXX for בַּיִת, פָּנִים and cognate forms ;]
__1. from within: Mc 7:21, 23, Lc 11:7.
__2. within: Mt 7:15 23:25-28, 2Co 7:5, Ap 4:8 5:1; τὸ ἔ., Lc 11:40; id. with genitive, Lc 11:39.†
(AS)

G2082.def:
ἐσώτερος, -α, -ον
(compar. of ἔσω), [in LXX chiefly for פְּנִימִי and cognate forms ;]
inner: At 16:24; τὸ ἐ., Hb 6:19.†
(AS)

G2083.def:
ἑταῖρος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ and cognate forms, also Sir.11:6 37:2 ff., al. ;]
a companion, comrade: Mt 11:16 (WH, ἑτέροις); voc., as term of address, my friend: Mt 20:13 22:12 26:50.†
(AS)

G2084.def:
ἑτερό-γλωσσος
(Att.. -ττος), -ον, [in Aq.: Sl 114:1, Is 33:19 * ;]
of alien speech, of another tongue (see Cremer, 681): 1Co 14:21 (aliter in LXX).†
(AS)

G2085.def:
ἑτεροδιδασκαλέω, -ῶ
to teach other or different doctrine: 1Tm 1:3 6:3 (cf. CGT, in l; Milligan, NTD, 102).†
(AS)

G2086.def:
ἑτερο-ζυγέω, -ῶ
[in LXX cf. ἑτερόζυγος, Lv 19:19 (יְקַמְעָם)* ;]
to be unequally yoked: metaphorically, with dative of person(s), 2Co 6:14.†
(AS)

G2087.def:
ἕτερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for אַחֵר ;]
distributive pron., prop. dual (BL, §13, 5; 51, 6), denoting the second of a pair, but in late Gk. encroaching on ἄλλος (M, Pr., 79f.);
__1. of number, other; with art., the other;
__(a) of two, Lc 5:7 9:56, al.; opposite to ὁ πρῶτος, Mt 21:30; ὁ εἷς, Mt 6:24, Lc 7:41, At 23:6, al.; ἕ. μὲν . . . ἕ. δέ, the one . . . the other: 1Co 15:40; the next: Lc 6:6 9:56 (sc. ἡμέρα, Xen.), At 20:15 27:3; = ὁ πλησίον, one's neighbour: Rm 2:1 13:8, 1Co 6:1, al.;
__(b) of more than two, another: Mt 8:21 11:3, Lc 6:6 22:65, Jo 19:37, Rm 8:39, al.; pl., At 2:13; οἱ μὲν . . . ἄλλοι δὲ . . . ἕ. δέ, Mt 16:14; τινὲς . . . ἕ. δέ, Lc 11:16.
__2. Of kind or quality, other, another, different (Plat., Dem., al.): Mrk.16:[12], Lc 9:29, At 2:4, 1Co 14:21, 2Co 11:4, Gl 1:6, al. (cf. ἑτερό-γλωσσος, -διδασκαλέω, -ζυγέω).
SYN.: ἄλλος, which see (see reff. ut supr., also Robertson, Gr., 748ff.). (AS)

G2089.def:
ἔτι
adv.,
yet, as yet, still;
__1. of time;
__(a) of the present (adhuc): Mc 5:35, 1Co 3:3 15:17, Gl 1:10, al.;
__(b) of the past, mostly with impf.: Mt 12:46, Lc 8:49 15:20, Jo 20:1, At 9:1, Rm 5:6, 8, 2Ts 2:5, Hb 7:10 9:8, al.;
__(with) of the future: Lc 1:15, 2Co 1:10;
__(d) with a neg.: Mt 5:13, Lc 16:2 20:36, Hb 10:2, Ap 3:12 20:3, al.
__2. Of degree, even, yet, still, further: with compar., Fp 1:9, Hb 7:15; of what remains, Mc 12:6, Jo 4:35 7:33, al.; of what is added, Mt 18:16 26:65, Hb 11:32 12:26-27; of con­tinuance apart from the idea of time, Rm 3:7 6:2 9:19, Gl 5:11; ἔτι δἐ, At 2:26 (LXX), Hb 11:36; ἔτι τε καί, Lc 14:26, At 21:28
(AS)

G2090.def:
ἑτοιμάζω
(ἕτοιμος), [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן hi. (Hatch, Essays, 51 a.) ;]
to prepare, make ready;
__(a) absol., of hospitable preparation: Mc 14:15, Lc 9:52 12:47 22:9, 12; with inf., Mt 26:17; ἵνα, Mc 14:12;
__(b) with accusative of thing(s): Mt 22:4 26:19, Mc 14:16, Lc 12:20 17:8 22:8, 13 23:56 24:1, Jo 14:2-3, Phm 22, Ap 9:7 16:12; before εἰς, 2Tm 2:21; of God's ordaining coming events (Dalman, Words, 128); of blessing, Mt 20:23 25:34, Mc 10:40, Lc 2:31, 1Co 2:9, Hb 11:16, Ap 12:6; of judgment, Mt 25:41; of preparation for the Messiah, τ. ὁδὸν κυρίου, Mt 3:3, Mc 1:3, Lc 1:76 3:4" (LXX) ;
__(with) with accusative of person(s): Lc 1:17, At 23:23, Ap 19:7, before ἵνα, Ap 8:6; εἰς, 2Tm 2:21, Ap 9:7, 15 21:2.†
(AS)

G2091.def:
ἑτοιμασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἑτοιμάζω, which see), [in LXX for כּוּן hi., כֵּן, מָכוֹן, and cognate forms, Et 2:68 3:3, Sl 10:17 65:9 89:14, Na 2:4, Zc 5:11, Eze.43:11, Da TH Dn 11:7, 20-21, Wis.13:12 * ;]
__1. = ἑτοιμότης,
__(a) readiness (Hipp.);
__(b) preparation (LXX; e.g. ἑ. τ. καρδίας, Sl 10:17): Ef 6:15, EV.
__2. foundation, firm footing (Sl 89:14): Eph, l.with (Hatch, Essays, 55; Exp. Times, ix, 38; but see also Abbott, Essays, 95).†
(AS)

G2092.def:
ἕτοιμος, -ον also (in cl. after Thuc.) -η (2Co 9:5, 1Pe 1:5), -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for כּוּן, מָכוֹן (cf. Hatch, Essays, 51 ff.) ;]
prepared, ready;
__(a) of things: Mt 22:4, 8, Mc 14:15, 2Co 9:5 10:16, 1Pe 1:5; ἔρχεσθε ὅτι ἤδη ἕτοιμά ἐστιν (Field, Notes, 67), Lc 14:17; ὁ καιρός, Jo 7:6;
__(b) of persons: Mt 24:44 25:10, Lc 12:40, At 23:21; before πρός, Tt 3:1, 1Pe 3:15; with inf., Lc 22:23; τοῦ, with inf. (WM, § 44, 4a; Robertson, Gr., 1068), At 23:15; ἐν ἑ. ἔχω (MM, Exp., xiv), with inf., 2Co 10:6.†
(AS)

G2093.def:
ἑτοίμως,
adv. [in LXX: Et 7:17 ff, Dan LXX TH Dn 3:15 * ;]
readily: 1Pe 4:5; ἑ. ἔχω, to be ready (Deiss., BS, 252; MM, Exp., xiv): with inf., At 21:13, 2Co 12:14.†
(AS)

G2094.def:
ἔτος, -ους, τό
[in LXX for שָׁנֶה ;]
a year: Lc 3:1, Hb 1:12, Ap 20:3, al.; ἔτη ἔχειν, Jo 5:5 8:57; εἶναι, γίνεσθαι, ἐτῶν, Mc 5:42, Lc 2:42, At 4:22, 1Tm 5:9; dative pl. of space of time, Jo 2:20, At 13:20; accusative, in ans. to how long? Mt 9:20, Mc 5:25, Lc 2:36, At 7:6, Hb 3:9, al.; preceded by a prep.: dim, Lc 8:43, Rm 15:23; διά, with genitive (see: διά), At 24:17, Gl 2:1; ἐκ, At 24:10; εἰς, Lc 12:19; ἐπί, with accusative, At 19:10; μετά, with accusative, Gl 1:18 3:17; πρό, with genitive, 2Co 12:2; κατ᾽ ἔτος, yearly, Lc 2:41
SYN.: ἐνιαυτός, which see; cf. LS, see word ἐνιαυτός (AS)

G2095.def:
εὖ
adv. (prop. neuter of old Epic ἐΰς, good, noble) [in LXX, εὖ γίγνεσθαι, εὖ ποιεῖν (יָטַב) ;]
well: εὖ γιν., Ef 6:3 (LXX); εὖ ποιεῖν, with dative (cf. Sir.12:1-2), to do good, Mc 14:7 (where Nestle suggests εὐποιεῖν, which see); εὖ πράσστειν, to fare well, At 15:29; in replies (= εὖγε), good! well done! Mt 25:21, 23 Lc 19:17 (εὖγε, WH, txt.).†
εὖ-γε,
adv.,
in replies, well! good! well done!: Lc 19:17 (WH for Rec. εὖ, which see).†
(AS)

G2096.def:
Εὔα (WH, Εὔα, § 408; Rec. Εὖα; S (in I Ti), Εὖα), -ας, ἡ (Heb. חַוָּה, Gn 3:20),
Eve, wife of Adam: 2Co 11:3, 1Tm 2:13.†
(AS)

G2097.def:
εὐαγγελίζω
[in LXX for בָּשַׂר pi., hith.; for good news in general: 1Rs 31:9, al.; of God's loving kindness, Sl 40:10 96:2, and esp. of Messianic blessings, Is 40:9 60:6, al. ;]
to bring or announce glad tidings;
__1. act. (only in late writers): with accusative of person(s), Ap 10:7; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Ap 14:6; pass., of things, to be proclaimed as glad tidings: Lc 16:16, Gl 1:11, 1Pe 1:25; impers., 1Pe 4:6; of persons, to have glad tidings proclaimed to one: Mt 11:5, Lc 7:22, Hb 4:2, 6
__2. Depon. mid. (cl.), to proclaim glad tidings, in NT esp. of the Christian message of salvation: absol., Lc 9:6, Rm 15:20, al.; with dative of person(s), Lc 4:18 (LXX), Rm 1:15, al.; in same sense with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Lc 3:18, At 16:10, Gl 1:9, 1Pe 1:12; with accusative of thing(s), εἰρήνην, At 10:36, Rm 10:15" (LXX) ; τ, βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, Lc 8:1; with dative of person(s), Lc 1:19 4:43, Ef 2:17 3:8; αὐτῷ τ. Ἰησοῦν, At 8:35 17:18; with dupl. accusative, At 13:32; with accusative of person(s) and inf., At 14:15; τ. κώμας (πολεῖς), At 8:25, 40 14:21 (cf. προ-ευαγγελίζομαι)
(AS)

G2098.def:
εὐαγγέλιον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for בְּשׂוֹרָה, 2Rs 4:10 18:22 18:25 * ;]
__1. in cl.,
__(a) a reward for good tidings (Hom.; pl., LXX, 2Rs 4:10);
__(b) in pl., εὐ. θύειν, to make a thank-offering for good tidings (Xen., al.).
__2. Later (Luc., Plut., al.), good tidings, good news; in NT of the good tidings of the kingdom of God and of salvation through Christ, the gospel: Mc 1:15, At 15:7, Rm 1:16, Gl 2:2, 1Ts 2:4, al.; with genitive obj., τ. βασιλείας, Mt 4:23; τ. Χριστοῦ, Rm 15:19, al.; τ. κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ, 2Ts 1:8; τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, Rm 1:9; τ. δόξης τ. μακαρίου θεοῦ, 1Tm 1:11; τ. δόξης τ. Χριστοῦ, 2Co 4:4; of the author, τ. θεοῦ, Rm 15:16, al.; of the teacher, ἡμῶν, Rm 2:16, 2Co 4:3, 1Ts 1:5, 2Tm 2:8; of the taught, τ. περιτομῆς, τ. ἀκροβυστίας, Gl 2:7; ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ εὐ., Gl 2:5, 14 Cl 1:5; ἡ ἐλπὶς (πίστις) τοῦ εὐ., Cl 1:23, Fp 1:27 (see Cremer, 31 ff.; and on the later eccl. use of the word„ M, Th., 143 f.)
(AS)

G2099.def:
εὐαγγελιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
an evangelist;
__(a) in NT, a preacher of the gospel: At 21:8, Ef 4:11, 2Tm 4:5;
__(b) later, a writer of a gospel (eccl.).†
(AS)
